rationale: P identifies the braking behavior that must be characterized to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. H-3 establishes sudden stopping without an obstacle as the hazardous event, SG-3 directly targets unintended braking, and FR-7 supports the obstacle-related justification for intended braking. The declared scope matches H-3. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing.
determining_elements: “Braking behavior of the ego vehicle” is itself the behavior targeted by H-3 and SG-3, rather than merely a mechanism affecting evaluation.
“Whether braking occurs” directly addresses the occurrence of the undesired behavior.
“Whether it is intended in response to a valid obstacle-related cause” is supported by H-3’s no-obstacle hazardous event and FR-7’s collision-avoidance braking function.
The scope retains H-3’s straight-ahead urban driving at 50 km/h, good weather, and absence of visible obstacles or vehicles ahead.
